title: Two small shell tools and their docs
acceptance: Goal: the repository ships greet.sh and count.sh, both documented in README.md. Acceptance: ./check.sh passes; greet.sh prints 'Hello, <name>!' for its first argument; count.sh prints the number of lines of the file it is given; README.md has a 'Tools' section describing both. Non-goals: tests, CI, packaging.

tracks.title: greet.sh
tracks.spec: Add an executable greet.sh at the repository root that prints 'Hello, <name>!' for its first argument, and 'Hello, world!' without one. Commit it.

tracks.title: count.sh
tracks.spec: Add an executable count.sh at the repository root that prints the number of lines of the file given as its first argument, and exits 1 with a message on stderr when the file does not exist. Commit it.

tracks.title: Document the tools
tracks.spec: Add a 'Tools' section to README.md that describes greet.sh and count.sh with one usage example each. Commit it.
